visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Indentation Is Not a Block
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array 2 5 8 9 12 has 3 even and 2 odd numbers, but the program says odds=5.

solution.explanation: C ignores indentation. Without braces only the first statement after the if belongs to it, so odds++ runs for every element. Use braces (and an else) so the intent is explicit.
